description: Export a kept reading as something that outlives this connector. format "html" returns ONE self-contained file — styles inlined, no network, opens in any browser years from now with nothing installed. "url" rebuilds a link against any renderer (yours by preference). "surface" returns the payload for repainting in place. "json" returns the decoded payload. Needs a reading saved WITH its payload; older link-only rows cannot be re-rendered and will say so.

format.description: Default html. "surface" returns the payload itself, for repainting in place.

id.description: Reading id from list_readings. OMIT for the most recent one.

name: export_reading

available.description: False when there is no signed-in reader or the store failed.

exported.description: True when an export was produced.
